abstract: Intra-abdominal neoplasmatic testicular torsion is a very rare clinical condition, which is normally not considered during differential diagnosis of acute appendicitis. The above-mentioned is most often observed in patients after puberty, without any previous specific symptoms apart from the absence of the testis in the scrotum and inguinal canal or periodic pain in the right lower abdomen. The study presented a case of a 22-year old male patient who was admitted and operated with suspicion of acute appendicitis. During surgery we observed intra-abdominal testicular torsion, both the testis and appendix were excised. Postoperative histopathological results were as follows: seminoma of the testis and normal appendix. The study presented available data concerning the above-mentioned rare clinical condition, as well as principles of diagnosis and treatment.
abstract_ja: 腹腔内の腫瘍性精巣捻転は非常にまれな臨床像であり、急性虫垂炎の鑑別診断で通常考慮されることはない。多くは思春期後の患者に発生し、精巣が陰嚢や鼠径管に存在しないこと、または右下腹部の間欠的な痛み以外には特段の症状を伴わないことが多い。今回、急性虫垂炎の疑いで手術を受けた22歳男性の症例を報告する。手術中に腹腔内精巣捻転が確認され、精巣と虫垂の両方を切除した。術後の病理組織学的所見は、精巣のセミノーマと正常な虫垂であった。本論文では、この稀な臨床状況に関する既存のデータと、診断および治療の原則を概説する。
